seo.title: Website Maintenance & Support | CloudTopia
seo.description: Keep your website fast, updated, backed up, and secure with proactive website maintenance and support from CloudTopia. Free consultation. Reach us on WhatsApp.

hero.title2: keeps your site fast, secure, and online
hero.subtitle: Launching a website is the start, not the finish. We handle the updates, backups, security patches, and content edits that keep yours running while you run your business — and you keep full ownership of the code and accounts the whole time.

features.heading: Ongoing care for a site you still fully own

items.title: Updates and security patches
items.description: We keep your CMS, plugins, themes, and dependencies current and patched, closing the vulnerabilities that outdated software quietly opens on a live site.

items.title: Backups and quick recovery
items.description: Scheduled off-site backups mean a bad update, hack, or human error never costs you the site — we can roll it back to a working version fast.

items.title: Content edits and small changes
items.description: Send us text tweaks, new pages, images, banners, or pricing updates in Arabic or English, and we make the changes for you instead of you wrestling with the dashboard.

items.title: Uptime, speed, and fixes
items.description: We monitor that your site stays online and loading fast, and when something breaks we diagnose and fix it rather than leaving you to guess what went wrong.

faqs.question: Do you maintain websites you didn't originally build?
faqs.answer: Yes. We take on sites built by other agencies or freelancers, whether they run on WordPress, a custom stack, or a page builder. We start with a quick review of how it's set up, then tell you honestly what it needs before any commitment.

faqs.question: What's actually covered under maintenance and support?
faqs.answer: Software and security updates, scheduled backups, uptime and performance monitoring, bug fixes, and small content or design edits. Larger work like a redesign or a new feature is scoped separately, and we'll always flag when a request crosses that line.

faqs.question: How quickly do you respond when something breaks?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us, and urgent issues like a site that's down or hacked are treated as priority. For everyday edits and requests we agree on a clear turnaround with you up front so you know what to expect.

faqs.question: If we use your maintenance, do we still own everything?
faqs.answer: Completely. The code, hosting, domain, and CMS accounts stay in your name throughout — we work inside your setup, not a locked platform of ours. You're free to move your site to another provider at any time, with no barriers over access or files.

faqs.question: Can you handle updates and content in both Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. We maintain bilingual and RTL sites as a standard part of the work, so edits, new pages, and fixes are handled correctly in both languages. Nothing breaks in your Arabic layout because a change was only tested in English.
